_about: Proof for the standing-fence memory (NeighbourPolishSystem.StandingOf: each house's fences and pieces as last read, until one of them changes): in the user's city '123' (read-only: loaded, never saved), with every 'Auto outgrow' switch on and knob checkStanding (every remembered house read again and compared), the whole city planned again and 90 s running. outgrowFrames' putInLine.standingFences says how many remembered houses were read again and how many had changed unseen (0 for the memory to be right); a warning line names the first ten.
